description: Validation-selected causal dynamic PCA under strict consecutive 10D-wing gaps.
selection_rule: Lowest mean validation MAE across 1, 5, 10 and 17 weekday gaps.
leak_control: PCA loadings, cell scaling and pair-specific score transitions use target-pair training surfaces only. Each gap is forecast recursively from the last complete pre-gap surface. Hidden gap wings are never used as model inputs or recursive updates.
